about: 관리 > 출/퇴근반영기준(E020725) → 근태항목등록(E020701) → 근태입력(E020710) [출/퇴근 ▲ › 사원기준] — 원본 2026-10-13 실측(QA01 지각 · 직접설정 09:00~18:00, 변종호 출근 14:08:35 · 퇴근 14:11:29 → 지각 일 1.00 · 시간 5.15 · 조퇴 3.82 · 근무 0.03). 반영기준을 [직접설정]으로 고르면 기준시간 · 오전반차설정 · 요일 · 업무일/휴일이 펴지고 계산단위 시간이면 최대시간 · 반영단위가 생긴다. 근태항목 유형 '출/퇴근'은 계산단위 대신 출/퇴근반영기준 코드도움(비우면 '출/퇴근반영기준을 입력 바랍니다.'). QA관리-사원1 이 10:30:25 출근 · 17:00 퇴근하면 셈은 지각 1.50 시간(초는 가까운 분으로 — 2차 실측 10:30:25 → 90분), 일별 적요 '출근: 10:30 / 퇴근: 17:00'. 근태입력은 계정(사용자) 기준이라 계정이 없는 사원은 줄을 못 깔고 그 이름을 알린다. 끝에 만든 것을 지운다.

shots.name: 출/퇴근반영기준 직접설정 · 시간 단위 칸
steps: js:(async()=>{const H={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const ks=await (await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds',{headers:H})).json();for(const k of ks.filter(k=>k.name==='QA관리-지각반영'))await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds/'+k.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});const rs=await (await fetch('/api/hr/commute-rules',{headers:H})).json();for(const r of rs.filter(r=>r.code==='QAGL01'))await fetch('/api/hr/commute-rules/'+r.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});return true})()

shots.name: 근태입력 출/퇴근 ▲ 사원기준 → 적용
steps: js:(async()=>{const H={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token'),'Content-Type':'application/json'};let es=await (await fetch('/api/employees/all',{headers:H})).json();let e=es.find(x=>x.name==='QA관리-사원1');if(!e)e=await (await fetch('/api/employees',{method:'POST',headers:H,body:JSON.stringify({code:'QAGL-E1',name:'QA관리-사원1'})})).json();const p=n=>String(n).padStart(2,'0');const t=new Date();let d=new Date(t);while(d.getDay()===0||d.getDay()===6)d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);const day=d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate());sessionStorage.setItem('qaGlDay',day);sessionStorage.setItem('qaGlEmp',e.id);const cs=await (await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes?from='+day+'&to='+day,{headers:H})).json();for(const c of cs.filter(c=>c.employeeId===e.id))await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes/'+c.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes/clock',{method:'POST',headers:H,body:JSON.stringify({employeeId:e.id,at:day+'T10:30:25',reason:'QA관리',out:false})});await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes/clock',{method:'POST',headers:H,body:JSON.stringify({employeeId:e.id,at:day+'T17:00:00',out:true})});return true})()

expect:(async()=>{const H={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const day=sessionStorage.getItem('qaGlDay');const ks=await (await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds',{headers:H})).json();const k=ks.find(k=>k.name==='QA관리-지각반영');const r=await (await fetch('/api/hr/commute-rules/reflect?mode=DAILY&from='+day+'&to='+day+'&kindIds='+k.id+'&employeeIds='+sessionStorage.getItem('qaGlEmp'),{headers:H})).json();return r.length===1&&Number(r[0].amount)===1.5&&r[0].note==='출근: 10:30 / 퇴근: 17:00'})()

js:(async()=>{const H={Authorization:'Bearer '+localStorage.getItem('erp_token')};const day=sessionStorage.getItem('qaGlDay');const emp=Number(sessionStorage.getItem('qaGlEmp'));const cs=await (await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes?from='+day+'&to='+day,{headers:H})).json();for(const c of cs.filter(c=>c.employeeId===emp))await fetch('/api/hr/employee-commutes/'+c.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});const ks=await (await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds',{headers:H})).json();for(const k of ks.filter(k=>k.name==='QA관리-지각반영'))await fetch('/api/hr/attendance-kinds/'+k.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});const rs=await (await fetch('/api/hr/commute-rules',{headers:H})).json();for(const r of rs.filter(r=>r.code==='QAGL01'))await fetch('/api/hr/commute-rules/'+r.id,{method:'DELETE',headers:H});return true})()
